doc: Intentional admission pauses. A listed row (id or id prefix) is never admitted, retried, relaunched or moved between hosts by any driver while its pause is active; its registration, checkpoints, replay and results are kept. Read by runs/setup/tools/admission_pause.py (remote_campaign_driver.py, stage2_local_driver.py, baseline_local_driver.py). Lifting a pause = setting active false with a reason.
